Every fund column has exactly one budget schedule in detail (General, Veterans Aid, Federal Grants and all 17 nonmajor funds incl. Gaming Tax, Assemble Lincoln, Highway); no column or schedule page is missing and no fund is in detail twice; the detail lines add to each schedule's printed total (detail_totals) and those totals add to 188,382,825. No printed revenue line is missing. Separately, one printed other-financing row was missing from detail: p13 Mental Health column 'Issuance of IT subscriptions' 338,046 (JSON other_financing 733,099 = sale of capital assets 395,053 + IT subscriptions 338,046); the Mental Health budget schedule p21 prints no such row and no existing detail line holds it, so it is added (section other financing; it does not change the revenue gap).
